entity: US 2017 home-purchase mortgage denials, Black vs white applicants, at large lenders
why:
Urban Institute puts the 2017 Black denial rate at 2.0x the white rate. CFPB/FFIEC says Black applicants were denied more often for 2017 conventional home-purchase loans. Same finding, same direction, same number.
Urban's 1.2x uses a credit-adjusted definition, so it isn't a contradiction. The lead adds 'at every big lender', but gives no lender-level number the press lacks, so this is plain Matched.
